∀ (K : ℕ) (L σ ε R γ Δ : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    0 < ε →
      0 ≤ R →
        0 < γ →
          L * γ * σ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 4 →
            ∀ (a b D F : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (I : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
              (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ b k) →
                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                    F (k + 1) ≤
                      F k - γ / 2 * a k - γ / 2 * (1 - L * γ) * b k + γ * L ^ 2 / 2 * D k + γ ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2) →
                  F 0 - F K ≤ Δ →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ), I k ⊆ Finset.Ico (p k) k) →
                      (∀ (k : ℕ), p k ≤ k) →
                        (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑k - ↑(p k) ≤ R) →
                          (∀ (k : ℕ), D k ≤ 2 * γ ^ 2 * ↑(I k).card * (∑ i ∈ I k, b i + σ ^ 2)) →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                L * γ * R * a k ≤ L * γ * R * (1 + L * γ * R) * b k + (1 + L * γ * R) * L ^ 2 * D k) →
                              (R = 0 → ∀ (k : ℕ), a k = b k) →
                                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, a k +
                                      (1 - L * γ - 2 * (L * γ * R) ^ 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, b k ≤
                                    2 * Δ / γ + ↑K * ε * (L * γ * σ ^ 2 / ε) * (1 + 2 * (L * γ * R)) ∧
                                  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, a k ≤
                                    (1 + L * γ * R) * (1 + 2 * (L * γ * R)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, b k +
                                      2 * (1 + L * γ * R) * (↑K * ε) * (L * γ * σ ^ 2 / ε)

∀ (K : ℕ) (L σ ε R Rt γ Δ : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    0 < ε →
      0 ≤ R →
        R + 1 ≤ Rt →
          0 ≤ Δ →
            0 < γ →
              L * γ * Rt ≤ 1 / 2 →
                L * γ * σ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 4 →
                  L * γ * Rt = 1 / 2 ∨ L * γ * σ ^ 2 = ε / 4 →
                    ∀ (a b D F : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (I : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
                      (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ b k) →
                        (∀ (k : ℕ),
                            F (k + 1) ≤
                              F k - γ / 2 * a k - γ / 2 * (1 - L * γ) * b k + γ * L ^ 2 / 2 * D k +
                                γ ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2) →
                          F 0 - F K ≤ Δ →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ), I k ⊆ Finset.Ico (p k) k) →
                              (∀ (k : ℕ), p k ≤ k) →
                                (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑k - ↑(p k) ≤ R) →
                                  (∀ (k : ℕ), D k ≤ 2 * γ ^ 2 * ↑(I k).card * (∑ i ∈ I k, b i + σ ^ 2)) →
                                    (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                        L * γ * R * a k ≤
                                          L * γ * R * (1 + L * γ * R) * b k + (1 + L * γ * R) * L ^ 2 * D k) →
                                      (R = 0 → ∀ (k : ℕ), a k = b k) →
                                        4 * Rt * L * Δ / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * Δ / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                                          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, a k ≤ ↑K * ε

                      (↑μ) f g σ →
                    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k η => η k) ↑μ ↑P →
                      ∀ (K : ℕ),
                        4 * (↑B + ↑M - 1) * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncTree M δ).IsMainBranch

                                              (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncStep L σ ε B M) x0 g η

  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (n s : ℕ) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 < s →
          s ≤ n →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k η => η k) ↑μ ↑P →
                    ∀ (K : ℕ),
                      8 * ↑n ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / (↑s * ε) + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                        (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).IsMainBranch
                            OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch ∧
                          (∀ (k : ℕ),
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun η =>
                                  ‖gradient f

                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s) x0 g η
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                    2)
                                ↑P) ∧
                            1 / ↑K *
                                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                  ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                    ‖gradient f
                                          ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).vertex
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s) x0 g η
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                      2 ∂↑P ≤
                              ε

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.general_rate
declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ ε R Rt lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 ≤ R →
          R + 1 ≤ Rt →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                    T.WellFormed →
                      T.IsMainBranch m →
                        LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε Rt)
                            x0 g ↑P →
                          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                              ∀ (K : ℕ),
                                4 * Rt * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                                  (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                        (fun η =>
                                          ‖gradient f
                                                (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε Rt) x0 g η
                                                  (m k))‖ ^
                                            2)
                                        ↑P) ∧
                                    1 / ↑K *
                                        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                          ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                            ‖gradient f
                                                  (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε Rt) x0 g η
                                                    (m k))‖ ^
                                              2 ∂↑P ≤
                                      ε

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.local_sgd_rate
declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ ε lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (n B : ℕ) (M : ℕ → Fin n → ℕ) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 < B →
          (∀ (r : ℕ), ∑ i, M r i = B) →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k η => η k) ↑μ ↑P →
                    ∀ (K : ℕ),
                      4 * ↑B * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                        (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.localTree n B M).IsMainBranch
                            OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch ∧
                          (∀ (k : ℕ),
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun η =>
                                  ‖gradient f
                                        ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.localTree n B M).vertex
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.localStep L σ ε B) x0 g η
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                    2)
                                ↑P) ∧
                            1 / ↑K *
                                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                  ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                    ‖gradient f
                                          ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.localTree n B M).vertex
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.localStep L σ ε B) x0 g η
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                      2 ∂↑P ≤
                              ε

declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ R : ℝ)
  (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
          (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
          (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
          0 < L →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g σ →
                (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                  LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m gamma x0 g ↑P →
                    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                      LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                        ∀ (k : ℕ),
                          ∃ p ≤ k,
                            ↑k - ↑p ≤ R ∧
                              ∃ I ⊆ Finset.Ico p k,
                                ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                    ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k) - T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P ≤
                                  2 * gamma ^ 2 * ↑I.card *
                                    (∑ i ∈ I,
                                        ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), ‖gradient f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i))‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P +
                                      σ ^ 2)

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.descent_point
declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (L σ gamma : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g σ →
        0 ≤ gamma →
          ∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun b => f (x - gamma • g y b)) ↑μ ∧
              ∫ (b : Ω), f (x - gamma • g y b) ∂↑μ ≤
                f x - gamma / 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 - gamma / 2 * (1 - L * gamma) * ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2 +
                    gamma * L ^ 2 / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 +
                  gamma ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2

∀ (q : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Public),
  q.tree.WellFormed →
    q.tree.IsMainBranch q.branch →
      ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
        (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d) (i : Fin (q.K + 1)) (η : ℕ → Ω),
        OracleTemplate.execute (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.gradientOracle P g) (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.birch q)
            (fun x => q.branch q.K) i η =
          q.tree.vertex q.gamma q.x0 g η (q.branch ↑i)

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ R : ℝ)
  (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
          (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
          (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
          0 < L →
            0 ≤ gamma →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m gamma x0 g ↑P →
                      LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                        LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                          ∀ (k : ℕ),
                            ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m (k + 1))) ∂↑P ≤
                              ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k)) ∂↑P -
                                      gamma / 2 * ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), ‖gradient f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k))‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P -
                                    gamma / 2 * (1 - L * gamma) *
                                      ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), ‖gradient f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k))‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P +
                                  gamma * L ^ 2 / 2 *
                                    ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                      ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k) - T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P +
                                gamma ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.foldHist_stable
declarations.type_text:
∀ {α : Type} (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (init : α) (step : ℕ → α → α) (k j : ℕ),
  j ≤ k → T.foldHist init step k j = T.fold init step j

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.fold_succ
declarations.type_text:
∀ {α : Type} (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (init : α) (step : ℕ → α → α) (j : ℕ),
  T.base j ≤ j → T.fold init step (j + 1) = step j (T.fold init step (T.base j))

∀ {Ξ Ω β : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ξ] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace β]
  (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (W : Ξ → β) (Y : Ξ → Ω),
  Measurable W →
    Measurable Y →
      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun W Y P →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P = μ →
          ∀ (Φ : β → Ω → ℝ),
            Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) →
              (∀ (w : β) (b : Ω), 0 ≤ Φ w b) →
                (∀ (w : β), MeasureTheory.Integrable (Φ w) μ) →
                  ∀ (B : Ξ → ℝ),
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable B P →
                      (∀ (ω : Ξ), ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (W ω) b ∂μ ≤ B ω) →
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Φ (W ω) (Y ω)) P ∧
                          ∫ (ω : Ξ), Φ (W ω) (Y ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ (ω : Ξ), B ω ∂P

  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (W : Ξ → β) (Y : Ξ → Ω),
  Measurable W →
    Measurable Y →
      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun W Y P →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P = μ →
          ∀ (Φ : β → Ω → ℝ),
            Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) →
              (∀ (w : β), MeasureTheory.Integrable (Φ w) μ) →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ∫ (b : Ω), ‖Φ (W ω) b‖ ∂μ) P →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Φ (W ω) (Y ω)) P ∧
                    ∫ (ω : Ξ), Φ (W ω) (Y ω) ∂P = ∫ (ω : Ξ), ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (W ω) b ∂μ ∂P

  Measurable W →

      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun W Y P →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P = μ →
          ∀ {E : Type} [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_6 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (Φ : β → Ω → E),
            MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry Φ) →

                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (W ω) b ∂μ) P ∧
                  ∫ (ω : Ξ), Φ (W ω) (Y ω) ∂P = ∫ (ω : Ξ), ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (W ω) b ∂μ ∂P

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ ε R lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 ≤ R →
          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g σ →
                (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                  T.WellFormed →
                    T.IsMainBranch m →
                      LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.stepSize L σ ε R) x0 g
                          ↑P →
                        LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                            ∀ (K : ℕ),
                              4 * (R + 1) * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (fun η =>
                                        ‖gradient f
                                              (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.stepSize L σ ε R) x0 g η (m k))‖ ^
                                          2)
                                      ↑P) ∧
                                  1 / ↑K *
                                      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                        ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                          ‖gradient f
                                                (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.stepSize L σ ε R) x0 g η (m k))‖ ^
                                            2 ∂↑P ≤
                                    ε

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ R : ℝ)
  (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
          (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
          (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
            LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
                σ →
              (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m gamma x0 g ↑P →
                  LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                      ∀ (k : ℕ),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun η => ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k)‖ ^ 2) ↑P ∧
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun η => ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)‖ ^ 2) ↑P ∧
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable
                              (fun η => ‖g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)) (η (T.auxSample m k))‖ ^ 2) ↑P

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ R : ℝ)
  (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
          (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
          (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
            LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
                σ →
              (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m gamma x0 g ↑P →
                  LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                      ∀ (k : ℕ),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun η => ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k)‖ ^ 2) ↑P →
                          (∀ i < k,
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun η => ‖g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)) (η (T.auxSample m i))‖ ^ 2) ↑P) →
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun η => ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)‖ ^ 2) ↑P ∧
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun η => ‖g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)) (η (T.auxSample m k))‖ ^ 2) ↑P

declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ R : ℝ)
  (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
          (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
          (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
          0 < L →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g σ →
                (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                  LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m gamma x0 g ↑P →
                    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                      LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                        ∀ (s : Finset ℕ),
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                              (fun η =>
                                ‖∑ i ∈ s,
                                      (g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)) (η (T.auxSample m i)) -
                                        gradient f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)))‖ ^
                                  2)
                              ↑P ∧
                            ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                ‖∑ i ∈ s,
                                      (g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)) (η (T.auxSample m i)) -
                                        gradient f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)))‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑P ≤
                              ↑s.card * σ ^ 2

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (R : ℝ),
          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
              ∀ (gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
                (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (k i : ℕ),
                i ≤ k →
                  ∃ F,
                    Measurable F ∧
                      ∀ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                        T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m i) =
                          F fun l =>
                            (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m (↑l + 1)), T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m (↑l + 1)),
                              η (T.auxSample m ↑l))

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (R : ℝ),
          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
              ∀ (gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
                (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (k i : ℕ),
                i ≤ k →
                  ∃ F,
                    Measurable F ∧
                      ∀ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                        T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i) =
                          F fun l =>
                            (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m (↑l + 1)), T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m (↑l + 1)),
                              η (T.auxSample m ↑l))

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.tree_gap
declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (R : ℝ),
          (∀ (k : ℕ), T.repr (T.auxNode m k) ≤ T.repr (m k)) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑(T.dist (m k) (T.auxNode m k)) ≤ R) →
              ∀ (gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
                (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (k : ℕ),
                ∃ p ≤ k,
                  ↑k - ↑p ≤ R ∧
                    ∃ I ⊆ Finset.Ico p k,
                      ∀ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                        T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k) =
                          T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k) +
                            gamma • ∑ i ∈ I, g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)) (η (T.auxSample m i))
